-3191864716212724441437776089064007362279269, 2810754273320080292398631682693082913502842]

def normalizedP : ℂ[X] := polynomialOfPairs (normalizedCoefficients.map (fun a => (a, 0)))

theorem normalized_length : normalizedCoefficients.length = 131 := by
  -- kcost: 0.1 s estimated;one shared list length.
  decide +kernel

theorem normalization_check : scaleIntCoefficients 1 2 normalizedCoefficients =
    scaleIntCoefficients 2 1 integerCoefficients := by
  -- kcost: 0.2 s estimated;131 exact rescaling identities, no polynomial translation.
  decide +kernel

theorem rational_integer_eval (as : List ℤ) (D : ℤ) (z : ℂ) :
    ((((polynomialFromCoeffs (as.map (fun (a : ℤ) => (a : ℚ) / (D : ℚ)))).map
      (algebraMap ℚ ℝ)).map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ))).eval z =
        evalPairs (as.map (fun a => (a, 0))) z / (D : ℂ) := by
  induction as with
  | nil => simp [polynomialFromCoeffs, evalPairs]
  | cons a as ih =>
    simp only [List.map_cons, polynomialFromCoeffs, Polynomial.map_add, Polynomial.map_mul,
      Polynomial.map_C, Polynomial.map_X, eval_add, eval_mul, eval_C, eval_X,
      evalPairs, castPair_real]
    rw [ih]
    simp only [map_div₀, map_intCast]
    push_cast
    ring

theorem realP_eval_eq_integer (z : ℂ) :
    (realP.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).eval z =
      evalPairs (integerCoefficients.map (fun a => (a, 0))) z / (coefficientDenominator : ℂ) := by
  rw [realP, rationalP, powerCoefficients_eq_integerCoefficients]
  exact rational_integer_eval integerCoefficients coefficientDenominator z

theorem normalized_eval_scaled (z : ℂ) : normalizedP.eval (2 * z) =
    2 * (coefficientDenominator : ℂ) * (realP.map (algebraMap ℝ ℂ)).eval z := by
  have ht := congrArg (fun as : List ℤ => evalPairs (as.map (fun a => (a, 0))) z) normalization_check
  rw [evalPairs_scaleIntCoefficients, evalPairs_scaleIntCoefficients] at ht
  have he : normalizedP.eval (2 * z) =
      2 * evalPairs (integerCoefficients.map (fun a => (a, 0))) z := by
    simpa only [normalizedP, polynomialOfPairs_eval, Int.cast_one, Int.cast_ofNat, one_mul] using ht
  rw [he, realP_eval_eq_integer]
  have hD : (coefficientDenominator : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast coefficientDenominator_pos.ne'
  field_simp
  <;> ring

end
end CatalanMeasure.GenD.Signed.Davis.Normalized130
